fourier_convention: integral f(x)*exp(2*pi*i*<x,y>) dx; radial real functions

selection_rule: smallest exact density bound among globally certified grid triples, ties by b,c,T

scope: Exact finite search and certificate; no claim of optimality outside this grid or novelty.
